message: Hi, I'm a student with a full stack certification background. My overall academic average is 78.7% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in programming and Business process analyst. I want to become a Applications Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 13400 per year. I live in Delhi. I'm open to anywhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in programming and Business process analyst roles

explanation:
This MBA Technology Management program in Delhi aligns well with your interest in Business Process Analyst and Applications Developer roles. It has a high placement rate (90%) and a strong median starting salary ($17361), making it excellent for job prospects while staying within your budget.

The MTech Computer Science program in Pune is highly relevant to becoming an Applications Developer, focusing on software engineering. With a high placement rate (93%) and strong salary ($19239), it offers excellent career growth potential while meeting your academic background requirements.

This MSc Software Quality Engineering program in Delhi is ideal for a technical role and has the highest median starting salary ($20639) among the top-ranked options. It provides strong job security and aligns with your interest in programming.

Located in Bengaluru, this MSc Software Quality Engineering program offers a high placement rate (95%) and excellent salary ($21062). It is highly technical and directly supports your goal of becoming an Applications Developer.

The MSc Information Security program in Mumbai provides specialized knowledge that complements both development and business analysis. It has a high placement rate (92%) and is technically focused, making it a solid choice for career advancement.
